pages.title: Sweet Cakes
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: In Sweet Cakes, draw a line through at least three matching treats to clear them. A higher score earns more rewards, which you can tap to remove extra pieces from the board. Watch for keys as you make matches and use them to open the locks that stand in your way.

pages.title: Arcade GP
pages.creator: Simplist
pages.description: Arcade GP puts you in a top-down Formula 1 race against computer-controlled drivers. While you’re watching the other cars and looking for room to pass, keep an eye on how much your tires have worn. Decide when to stop for fresh tires and when to stay on the track to hold your position.

pages.title: Royal Crown Blast
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Tap two or more neighboring blocks of the same color in Royal Crown Blast. Each level has its own goal, such as collecting a color or freeing crowns. Bigger groups can trigger boosters, and clearing blocks lets new ones drop into place for your next move.

pages.title: Water Junk Warriors
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Clean up riverbanks, beaches, and canals in Water Junk Warriors. Drag litter onto the collector and pair identical items to score points. Keep matching the rubbish you pull from the water and the shore to meet each cleanup target and see the scene change.

pages.title: Charger City Driver
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Take a muscle car out after dark in Charger City Driver. Explore the city with your dog, try the four driving challenges, and look for speed, stunt, and drift events around the map. Use nitro to get past slow traffic, then customize or upgrade the car before the next challenge.

pages.title: Summer Rider 3D
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Ride a surfboard or jet ski through an endless stretch of water in Summer Rider 3D. Pick up starfish and steer clear of obstacles as the pace gets faster. You can try to stretch your run in solo mode or head onto the water with a friend in the two-player mode.

pages.title: Battle of Pirate Caribbean Battle
pages.creator: T-rex Games
pages.description: Command a pirate ship in Battle of Pirate Caribbean Battle. Sail into fights with rival pirates, warships, and sea monsters, using your cannons to defend the ship and deal damage. Look for an opening to attack while you steer through the encounter and position the ship for another shot.

pages.title: Boolu Bask
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: Slide the basket left and right in Boolu Bask to catch falling basketballs. Watch where each ball is headed and move the hoop into place before it drops past you. You start with three lives, so try to keep the misses down while you build your score.

pages.title: Pixel Path
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Reach the portal in Pixel Path, a platformer that changes the rules under your feet. A floor may collapse, spikes can come toward you, and your character can suddenly grow. Learn where each surprise happens so you can get through the level, then try to finish faster for a spot on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Drive Ahead Sports
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Play soccer from behind the wheel in Drive Ahead Sports. Drive into the ball to send it toward the opposing goal and get back into position when the other vehicle takes possession. Judge your approach before making contact so the ball goes where you want it to.

pages.title: Cat Evolution
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run an obstacle course as a cat in Cat Evolution. Collect meat to evolve into bigger animals and steer away from vegetables that reverse your progress. Pick up diamonds for upgrades along the way and try to reach the finish as a tiger or a more advanced form.

pages.title: Money Factory - Earn a Billion
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Build up a network of money-making mechanisms in Money Factory - Earn a Billion. Drag boosters into place and combine identical ones to improve your earnings. Decide how to fill the field as you unlock new levels and work toward the game’s billion-dollar goal.

pages.title: Falling Blocks - Halloween Challenge
pages.creator: KTV
pages.description: Falling Blocks - Halloween Challenge sends pumpkins, skulls, and ghosts tumbling into the play area. Match at least three of a kind to make space before the blocks pile up. Watch for opportunities to connect the falling pieces with ones already on the board and keep clearing groups to build your score.

pages.title: That's Not My Neighbor
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Check visitors at the entrance to an apartment building in That's Not My Neighbor. Some are monsters disguised as the people who live there, so study each face for flaws and fill out the checklist before making a decision. The tutorial shows you what to look for before your first shift.

pages.title: Zen Mini Games 2
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Zen Mini Games 2 switches between several kinds of small puzzles. In one, your job is to drop all the balls into empty boxes and keep them from spilling out. The challenges get harder as you go, so take a moment to work out what each new setup asks you to do.

pages.title: Fish Resort
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Raise a tank of colorful fish in Fish Resort. Feed them, care for any that get sick, and keep them safe when a shark appears. Healthy, happy fish bring in money that you can use to buy better food, expand the tank, and add new species.

pages.title: Word Maker
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Piece together a word from nine syllables in Word Maker. Some of the syllables are decoys, so work out which ones fit and put them in order. Discover facts about the words you solve across 500 levels and use daily bonuses for hints when you get stuck.

pages.title: Fall Red Stickman
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Run and jump into a ragdoll fall in Fall Red Stickman. Your score comes from the damage the stickman takes, so try changing the speed or timing of your jump to see how the fall plays out. Higher scores help you unlock more levels with different places to take a tumble.

pages.title: CARD MATCH 10
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: In CARD MATCH 10, remove cards by collecting values that add up to ten. Check the cards already in your hand before you pick another one, because a full hand can end the attempt. Clear the stage’s target by planning which numbers to combine and leaving room for future picks.

pages.title: Super Pinball
pages.creator: happyGames
pages.description: Launch balls at the shapes in Super Pinball and try to knock them out before they reach the bottom line. Pick an angle that sends your shot into several pieces, and grab helpful items as you go. Some items add more balls to your next attack.

pages.title: Fridge Master
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Fit a load of groceries into the available space in Fridge Master. Click an item to put it into the freezer and look at how much room is left for the rest of your purchases. Choose where to start so a large item can still fit after you’ve placed the smaller ones.

pages.title: Taxi Driver
pages.creator: FreezeNova.Games
pages.description: Take passengers to their destinations in Taxi Driver. Thread the taxi through busy traffic and try to deliver each fare quickly, since faster trips can bring in more money. Keep an eye on the other cars as you look for a clear route through the street.

pages.title: Hidden Candies
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Search the scenes in Hidden Candies for sweets tucked among the other details. Tap a candy when you spot it and keep looking until you’ve found every one in the scene. The game has 16 levels, with a fresh picture to examine each time you finish a search.

pages.title: Speed Moto Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Take a motorcycle onto a 3D circuit in Speed Moto Racing and compete against other riders. Look ahead to the next corner and judge when to ease off or accelerate so you can make up ground. Try the different tracks as you work on keeping pace with the field.

pages.title: Blockz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Rotate and move falling blocks in Blockz! so they fit into the gaps below. Complete horizontal lines to clear them and make room for the next pieces. Each level gives you a line-clearing target, so keep the stack manageable while you work toward the required number.

pages.title: Baby Beauty Salon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Give up to four baby girls a makeover in Baby Beauty Salon. Work on each girl separately and try the available customization options until you find a look you like. Switch to another girl to experiment with a different combination and give each one an individual style.

pages.title: Flick Rugby
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Send a rugby ball toward the posts with a flick in Flick Rugby. Adjust the next kick when the setup changes and see how many you can land in a row. Keep scoring to build up your progress and unlock different rugby balls from the store.

pages.title: Fruit Adventure
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Guide a strawberry through the forest in Fruit Adventure. Jump on the sweets in your path, keep clear of spikes, and watch out for the chocolates as you make your way through each level. Find the key before reaching the portal so you can open it and move on.

pages.title: Colors Run
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Change the color of the ring at the bottom of the screen in Colors Run. Match it to the ball approaching next by pressing the corresponding colored button. Keep following the incoming colors and switch the ring in time to catch as many balls as you can.

pages.title: Anime Love Balls Girls
pages.creator: d954mas
pages.description: Link three or more balls showing the same girl in Anime Love Balls Girls. Look for longer chains to earn more points and build up affection before the timer runs out. When you finish a chain, check the board for another group you can connect.

pages.title: Tanks.io
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Work with a team in Tanks.io to destroy the opposing base. Drive your tank into battle, watch where the enemy is advancing, and find a route that lets you fire on their base. Keep up the attack until its health is depleted while the other team tries to do the same to yours.

pages.title: Draw Defence
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Draw lines to summon defenders in Draw Defence, a tower defense game built around protecting a castle. Different shapes call in different types of soldiers, so choose what to draw based on the attackers approaching. Improve your equipment as the enemy gets stronger so your defenses can keep up.

pages.title: Tangle Master 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Untangle a bundle of cables in Tangle Master 3D by moving their plugs. Follow each wire to see where it crosses the others, then unplug and reconnect the ends one at a time. Plan where a plug needs to go so the move actually clears a crossing.

pages.title: Tie Dye
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Make patterns on shirts, skirts, and other clothes in Tie Dye. Try your own colors or use the game’s suggestions to guide a design, then sell the garment once you’ve finished dyeing it. Pick a different piece to see how the colors look on another style of clothing.

pages.title: Super Merge
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: In Super Merge, swipe to slide the colored figures across the board. Bring figures of the same color together to combine them into a larger one, then look for another match. Work through the layout a few moves at a time until the group is down to a single figure.

pages.title: King Of Strings
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play rock guitar tracks in King Of Strings by hitting notes as they drop. Use the arrow keys or the touch controls, depending on how you’re playing. The tutorial gives you a chance to learn the timing before trying the songs at different difficulties, and three missed notes end the attempt.

pages.title: Super Dash Car
pages.creator: comeplay
pages.description: Get past the cars ahead in Super Dash Car. Drive along the road and use jumps to overtake when you see a chance to get clear. Watch the traffic as you approach, then time the jump so you can carry on down the road after passing.

pages.title: Golf Blast
pages.creator: True Valhalla
pages.description: Go for a hole-in-one in Golf Blast. The courses are generated for you, so check the shape of the ground and the position of the hole before aiming. A bunker can get in the way or become part of your route, depending on how you play the shot.

pages.title: Hexable
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fit hexagon pieces into the empty spaces in Hexable. Complete a line to clear it, or try to line up a placement that clears two or more at once for a combo. Leave space for later pieces as you build your score and earn money for new skins.

pages.title: Bloody Millionaire
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Reach for the money in Bloody Millionaire while a guillotine hangs over it. Watch the blade and time each reach for when there’s room to get your hand through. A mistimed grab can end the attempt, so take the cash and pull back before the blade drops.

pages.title: Jungle Balloons Rounding
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Drag the numbered balloons to the answers they round to in Jungle Balloons Rounding. Every correct drop adds 100 points, while a mistake costs 50. Look closely at each number before choosing its match, and keep going until you reach the 500 points needed to finish the level.

pages.title: Horror Nights Story
pages.creator: Paper Bunker
pages.description: Dig an escape tunnel in Horror Nights Story while ghosts and bats try to reach you. Over five nights, use your pickaxe to make progress and plant a C4 charge at the end of the tunnel. Keep the oxygen generator running and watch for blackouts as you move between rooms.

pages.title: Zombie Robogeddon
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Tap the incoming zombies in Zombie Robogeddon to stop them. The screen shows how many are left in the current level, so watch that count as you clear the group. Keep looking around for the next zombie to appear and finish the level by taking out the remaining targets.

pages.title: Shark io
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Swim through Shark io looking for smaller fish to eat. Keep clear of larger fish while you move toward prey your shark can handle. Size determines who can eat whom, so look at what’s swimming nearby before heading toward a group and use smaller targets to build your score.

pages.title: What Comes Next
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Look at a sequence of objects in What Comes Next and figure out which one belongs in the blank. Drag your answer into place to finish the pattern. Follow the order from the start of the row so you can tell which item should repeat next.

pages.title: CandyMatch.io
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Work through 100 match-three levels in CandyMatch.io. Look for candies that can be brought together in groups of three, then use the changes on the board to plan your next match. Try the different game modes for a change of pace as you play through the puzzles.

pages.title: Love Test
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Enter two names in Love Test to get a compatibility result. Submit them as a pair and see what the game gives you, or try a different combination of names to see another result. It’s a quick guessing game you can share with a friend.

pages.title: Sweet Candy Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Trace a path through three or more matching candies in Sweet Candy Collection. The candies can touch horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Collect the requested types before the timer ends, and look for longer chains to earn bonuses, including extra time when you connect more than seven pieces.

pages.title: Demolition Derby2
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Race and ram other cars in Demolition Derby2. Enter banger races or destruction derbies, and take a drive in the open world between events. You can customize and upgrade your vehicles, then see how they handle when the next race turns into a fight for position.

pages.title: Xmas Match Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Swap neighboring presents in Xmas Match Deluxe to make rows or columns of three matching gifts. Each stage asks you to collect specific gifts before your turns run out. Bigger matches can earn spells you can use on the board, while the hint and double spells activate when clicked.

pages.title: Ludo Online Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Play a Christmas-themed game of Ludo against the computer in Ludo Online Xmas, or go online to face a randomly matched opponent. For a game with friends, set up a private match and share the code so they can join. Then race to bring your pieces home.

pages.title: Christmas 2019 Differences 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Compare two holiday pictures in Christmas 2019 Differences 2 and click the details that have changed. Find every difference before time runs out. A faster search earns a higher score, and you can use the hint button if there’s one detail you still can’t find.

pages.title: Halloween Helix
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide a bouncing piece down a stack of platforms in Halloween Helix. Rotate the tower to line up an opening below, then keep turning it to find a path through the next layer. See how far you can descend in the endless mode and try out different Halloween skins.

pages.title: FZ Halloween Memory
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Flip Halloween-themed cards in FZ Halloween Memory and remember which pictures are under them. When you find an identical image, go back to the card you saw earlier to make a pair. Keep matching the pictures until you’ve cleared the board.

pages.title: Math Whizz 2
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pick the operator that makes each equation work in Math Whizz 2. Read the numbers and the result, then decide which operation connects them. You have one minute to solve as many equations as possible, so check each one quickly before moving to the next.

pages.title: Cowboy Run
pages.creator: c2gamesstudio
pages.description: See how far you can take a cowboy through Cowboy Run. Pick up coins, extra lives, and ammunition along the way, then use your shots to deal with the monsters in your path. Keep an eye out for supplies while trying to stretch the distance of your run.

pages.title: Classic Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Clear the cards from the board in Classic Spider Solitaire. Arrange them in descending order to assemble full runs from king to ace, then remove the finished sequences. Play with one suit to keep the combinations simple, or choose two or four suits for a harder game.

pages.title: Robots Titans Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Put together one of 12 robot pictures in Robots Titans Jigsaw. Choose a puzzle with 25, 49, or 100 pieces, then fit the scattered pieces together to restore the picture. Start with a recognizable part of a robot or look for edges to build the frame.

pages.title: Candy Match 3
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Bring three or more identical pieces together in Candy Match 3 to clear a group. Look over the colors and shapes on the board to see where you can make a match, then check the new layout for the next one. Keep matching as the board changes.

pages.title: Impossible Stunt Tracks
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take a car through the courses in Impossible Stunt Tracks. Steer carefully around the bends and control your speed as you approach the next stretch of track. Work through the driving levels and try the different car skins to change how your vehicle looks on the course.

pages.title: Sushi Chef
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Swap sushi pieces to make matches in Sushi Chef and keep the restaurant’s customers happy. Watch for matches you can make quickly while the diners are still willing to wait. Good service can earn you a promotion to another restaurant, while poor service can send you back a level.

pages.title: Gak iso turu
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Try to get some sleep in Gak iso turu and make it through to 5 a.m. Keep checking the windows, cabinet, and door when disturbances interrupt the night. The threats can return within seconds, so move your attention between entrances as you try to keep her out.

pages.title: Magic Coloring Book
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a picture and start adding color in Magic Coloring Book. Pick colors from the palette and use the brush for details or the fill tool for larger areas. The game includes mandala designs, so you can try a repeating color scheme or give each section a different shade.

pages.title: Chopstick Cooking
pages.creator: Cat Summer
pages.description: Catch ingredients out of the air and assemble burgers to order in Chopstick Cooking. Remember what the customer asked for as the food flies by and choose only the ingredients you need. A wrong ingredient can upset the customer and cost you some of your remaining time.

pages.title: Extreme Baseball
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Aim a baseball at the opponents in Extreme Baseball and use the walls to bounce it into more than one target. Glass, boxes, moving platforms, and explosives can change the route of a shot. Pick up baseball cards to add to your score as you work through the puzzles.

pages.title: Kitty Wedding Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Kitty get ready for her wedding in Kitty Wedding Day. Pick a dress and put together shoes and accessories to go with it. Once Kitty’s outfit is ready, move to the garden and choose decorations for the place where she’ll celebrate with her friends.

pages.title: Sniper 3D City Apocalypse
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Use a sniper rifle to hold off advancing zombies in Sniper 3D City Apocalypse. Watch the streets of the abandoned city and aim carefully as the undead close in. Accurate shots can earn extra points and a bonus that improves your rifle for the fight ahead.

pages.title: Ice Bucket Challenge President Edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Drop buckets of ice on presidents in Ice Bucket Challenge President Edition. Watch the characters and tap the buttons quickly when the right person appears. The pink bunny is the exception, so check who’s there before tipping a bucket to avoid soaking it by mistake.

pages.title: Beautiful Spot Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Study two pictures side by side in Beautiful Spot Differences and pick out what has changed. Click a difference as soon as you find it and keep searching before the timer runs out. Finishing sooner improves your score, and there’s a hint button when you get stuck.

pages.title: Cat Solitaire
pages.creator: CMC Online s.r.o.
pages.description: Move cards into descending stacks of alternating colors in Cat Solitaire. As you free up cards, build each foundation from ace through king. Look for moves that reveal a useful card underneath or let you transfer another card to the foundations and get closer to clearing the board.

pages.title: Dog Spot the Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find 25 differences across five pairs of dog pictures in Dog Spot the Difference. Look closely for details that appear on one side and change on the other, then select them as you find them. The game has no timer, so you can take a closer look whenever two pictures seem identical.

pages.title: Freecell solitaire!
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Rearrange cards in descending order in Freecell solitaire! Use the spare cells to hold cards temporarily while you uncover what you need and move cards to the foundations. Work through the layout at your own pace or play again to try to improve your score.

pages.title: Nimble Boxes
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description: Tap to jump in Nimble Boxes and time each leap as the path comes toward you. Pick up coins on a run and spend them to unlock different avatars. Try another character and see how far you can get as you work toward a new high score.

pages.title: Kitty Diver
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a submerged cat get back to safety in Kitty Diver. Click objects in the scene to change what’s in the cat’s way and make it move upward. Check where the fish, bombs, and other obstacles are before touching anything so you can guide the cat past them.

pages.title: Princess New Hobby
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Make a custom fidget spinner for Elsa and Snow White in Princess New Hobby. Give each princess her own spinner design, then choose outfits for the party. Try to find clothes that suit the spinner you made before sending the two of them out to show off their new hobby.

pages.title: General Rocket
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Jump across a sky full of rockets in General Rocket. Time each leap so you can land on another rocket and use it to keep moving. The rockets are moving too, so watch for where they’ll be when you come down and see how long you can keep the run going.

pages.title: My Totoro Room
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Decorate a Totoro-themed bedroom in My Totoro Room. Pick the walls and flooring, choose a bed and its cover, and fill out the room with lamps, toys, or other furnishings. When you’ve settled on a design, use the preview to see how the whole room looks together.

pages.title: Flirting on School
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Get the boys’ attention with laser eyes in Flirting on School. Other girls are after the same boys, so get to them first and keep an eye out for rivals who can steal their attention. See how many hearts you can win as you move around the school.

pages.title: Barbie Pregnancy Care
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Care for Barbie before the baby arrives in Barbie Pregnancy Care. Figure out which snacks she wants first, then blend fruit and milk into a smoothie. Help her relax with music and a foot massage before checking her blood pressure and listening to the baby’s heartbeat.
